title: Mega menu
description: A site header with a Resources menu that opens a wide panel of links. Each tile lights up and plays its icon when you point at it.
pageTitle: Mega Menu Navigation with Animated Icon Tiles | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: Use it on marketing sites and SaaS products with lots of resources, like docs, guides, blog and community. A wide panel shows each destination with a short description, and a featured card promotes your latest content. It keeps the header clean while making deep pages easy to find.
whenToUse.alt: Animated mega menu: Resources panel opens with link tiles that light up and play their icons on hover

accessibility: A nav landmark labelled "Main" holds the top links and the Resources button. Every tile in the panel is one real link.
The Resources trigger is a native button with `aria-expanded`, and the panel closes with Escape.
Panel sections are labelled by their headings.
iconsNote: The icons in this menu use the default Hover state, so any System Outline or System Solid icon will fit. Stick with the default animation, as In, Morph and Loop states don’t work well here.
